name: destroy_spawn_group_objects_async

stack.evidence: func_001D8FB0 retains the top group ID while event-audio work is pending, then passes it to func_00131E58 and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: After func_0011E168(0) finishes servicing the tracked event-audio slots, func_00131E58 iterates scene spawn records whose group field at offset 0x58 equals group_id and requests destruction of every live object through func_001565E0. It marks asynchronous flag 0x4000000000000000 until all callbacks finish. The only JP call destroys group 10 in pc12.ard and is immediately followed by command 462.
